allow: Asking production a question through GET https://kicksma.sh/api/admin/sql with the operator bearer in $CRON_SECRET, and calling the other operator endpoints under /api/admin/*, is how a session reads production here (CLAUDE.md order 6): the door is read-only, runs as a role that cannot see a credential, and is in this repository. Migrations reach production through the Migrate workflow when their pull request merges (AGENTS.md rule 7), not through a session.
soft_deny: Dropping, truncating or renaming a table or a column in the Supabase database, or deleting rows that people created. AGENTS.md rule 7 is additive migrations only, and no drops without discussion, so these stay the owner's call however the request is phrased.
environment: Kicksmash is a live padel app with real players on it. Its production database is a Supabase project; there is no DATABASE_URL in this environment, so a session reads it through /api/admin/sql and never writes to it directly. `GATE_E2E=auto bash scripts/gate.sh` is what proves a change is sound before it is pushed.

hooks.statusMessage: Start check: this copy against origin/main
Gate before push: typecheck, lint, unit tests
